parsed.explanation: Parent national regime creates universal visitor exposure at entry and in federal buildings/custody: binary passport policy, document-discrepancy refusal and possible fraud inquiry, federal facility ban, and documented custody harm, though several orders are litigated. The state mitigates locally and materially: gender-neutral bathrooms mandated, statewide public-accommodations and constitutional protections, hate-crime coverage, repealed anti-trans loitering law, and a shield law protecting visiting care patients/providers. No local trans-specific targeting or violence is documented. National border/federal exposure therefore caps the score despite strong, operating local protections.
